newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures quiet before FOMC.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures quiet before FOMC.

text.p: July 2 - U.S. stock index futures were holding slight gains in quiet trading, marking time before the conclusion of the FOMC meeting. Sept S&Ps have carved a narrow range so far this session, moving between 904.00 and 899.75. Some stock index traders expect a rally if rates left unchanged. The FOMC decision is expected at 1415 EDT/1815 GMT.
